rows.q: Who was known as Dr Angelicus?
rows.text: Dr. Angelicus was a title given to **St. Thomas Aquinas**, the 13th-century Italian philosopher and theologian. He was called "Doctor Angelicus" (the Angelic Doctor) due to his deep wisdom, clarity of thought, and association with angelic purity and intelligence. The title reflects both his intellectual brilliance and his theological depth.
